title: Minecraft Overtaken
subtitle: A Missionary's Guide to Reclaiming the Blocky World
genre: Minecraft mission guide / playable game log
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: The world of Minecraft has been overtaken by shadow and chaos. You are the missionary of the block, commissioned to take the world back one mission at a time. Each mission has a briefing, an objective, supplies, exact coordinates, a step-by-step plan, a success checklist, and a missionary note. The campaign escalates forever: every day a new, harder mission is added.
style: Direct, instructive, second-person missionary voice. Military-briefing precision crossed with devotional warmth. Concrete block counts and exact X/Y/Z coordinates (sea level Y = 63, spawn at (0, 63, 0)). Numbered plan steps with bold lead-ins. Italic missionary notes that reflect on light, work, and the reclamation.
characters: You, the missionary of the block — the last builder commissioned by the Old Builders. The Old Builders (gone, their works fallen to shadow). Creatures of the dark: zombies, skeletons, creepers, the Warden, the Ender Dragon, the elder guardians.
setting: A Minecraft world (Java Edition, seed OVERTAKEN, survival, no cheats). Spawn at (0, 63, 0). 15 missions reclaimed the Overworld: home (24,64,12), farm (-45,63,80), Lantern Road to (100,64,100), Watchtower (-120,64,-40), mine (50,16,-70), strongroom (200,30,300), Ironworks (350,64,100), Chasm Bridge (400,70,-200), Nether gate (500,64,-400), Redstone River (620-676,63,300), stronghold (812,34,213), End conquered, ocean monument (950,62,-500), sky city (1200,150,800), and the Beacon of Overtaking at (0,67,0).
notes: The epilogue ('## EPILOGUE — THE OVERTAKING') closed the original 15-mission campaign and ended with: 'Go, and take the next world back.' New missions continue AFTER the epilogue and BEFORE '## APPENDIX A'. A deeper darkness stirs: the Old Builders' mistakes wake beneath the world. Missions 16-20 = TIER IV — EXPERT, 21-25 = TIER V — NIGHTMARE, 26-30 = TIER VI — LEGENDARY, 31-35 = TIER VII — MYTHIC, then TIER VIII — APOCALYPTIC and beyond. Each daily mission must be HARDER than the last, escalating relentlessly.
